mapper.sql: c.id, c.workspace_id, c.organization_id, c.created_by_id, c.membership_id, c.name, c.token_hash, c.token_last4, c.expires_at, c.last_used_at, c.revoked_at, c.revoked_by_id, c.created_at, c.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT s.scope FROM api_credential_scope s JOIN api_credential c ON c.id = s.credential_id WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.credential_id = #{credentialId} ORDER BY s.scope
SELECT FROM api_credential c WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_credential (workspace_id, organization_id, created_by_id, membership_id, name, token_hash, token_last4, expires_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{organizationId}, #{createdById}, #{membershipId}, #{name}, #{tokenHash}, #{tokenLast4}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE api_credential SET last_used_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM api_credential c WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.created_by_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT workspace_id AS workspaceId, organization_id AS organizationId FROM api_credential WHERE created_by_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT workspace_id AS workspaceId, organization_id AS organizationId FROM api_credential WHERE revoked_by_id = #{userId} ORDER BY workspaceId, organizationId
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM api_credential WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND created_by_id = #{userId}
DELETE FROM api_credential WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
